event_name: Document 33 Date 17 November 2019 Time 14:54 2019 BRAZILIAN GRAND PRIX 14 - 17 November 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Incident between car 3 and car 20 in turn 4.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV Article 2 of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence from multiple angles including on-board cameras, broadcast cameras and CCTV. Approaching Turn 4 Car 3 moved to the inside of Car 20 to attempt a pass. At the apex of the corner, Car 3 had a slight lock up of the left front which caused him to understeer and a collision ensued at the exit of the corner. The Stewards determined that Car 3 was predominantly at fault.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 3 Incident With Car 20 In Turn 4
to: The Team Manager, Renault F1 Team
